# Bounded reusable BOT storage Back, LUN0, LBA0, one 512-byte block per request.
# Sixteen Source-owned CBWs use distinct tags; current-head proof remains pending.
type BotControlFacts = {
    descriptor: Boolean
    ack: Boolean
}
type BotReadFacts = {
    result: UsbEndpointReadResult
    data: Boolean
    status: Boolean
}
type BotEvent =
    control BotControlFacts
    | write UsbEndpointWriteResult
    | read BotReadFacts
type BotState = {
    command: UsbEndpointWriteRequest
    phase: U64
    transaction: U64
    terminal: Boolean
    refused: Boolean
}
type BotRoute =
    control BotState
    | write BotState
    | read BotState
    | stopped BotState
type BotPending =
    running BotState
    | stopped
type BotTransition = {
    previous: BotState
    accepted: Boolean
}
type BotOutcome =
    accepted
    | refused
type BotDataCandidate =
    ready BotEvent
    | absent
type BotAcceptedState =
    ready BotState
    | refused

# Request-driven first-profile read-only BOT realization; no media write API.
type BotStorageControl = {
    result: UsbControlResult
    facts: BotControlFacts
}
type BotStorageReadFacts = {
    result: UsbEndpointReadResult
    ordinal: U64
    data: Boolean
    status: Boolean
    tag: U64
    residue: U64
    status_code: U64
}
type BotStorageObservation =
    write UsbEndpointWriteResult
    | read BotStorageReadFacts
type BotStorageEvent =
    startup Bytes <= 2048B
    | closed
    | command BlockReadRequest
    | control BotStorageControl
    | observation BotStorageObservation
type BotStorageState = {
    bank: Bytes <= 2048B
    command: UsbEndpointWriteRequest
    request: BlockReadRequest
    data: UsbEndpointReadResult
    phase: U64
    operations: U64
    terminal: Boolean
}
type BotStorageRoute =
    ready BotStorageState
    | control BotStorageState
    | write BotStorageState
    | read BotStorageState
    | stopped BotStorageState
type BotStoragePending =
    running BotStorageState
    | stopped
type BotStorageTransition = {
    previous: BotStorageState
    event: BotStorageEvent
    accepted: Boolean
}
type BotStorageEmission =
    emit BlockReadResult
    | absent

# Phase7 drains queued semantic commands effect-free; only explicit closed
# reaches terminal phase8. The first failure alone emits its original identity.
# Sixteen CBWs are authored immutable Source configuration with unique tags1..16.
# Checked ordinal selection borrows exactly one31-byte window. No Rust class mutation.
# The CBW bank is authored immutable Source configuration, not an extra semantic
# input and not a Rust class constructor. Only LBA0/count1/512 is supported.
# Root must separately admit storage ownership AND the original USB subordinate
# calls; this selected Back never derives storage authority from enumeration.
# Exact identity preserves the unchanged value's finite input/output contract.
plot bot-storage-result (
    observed: BlockReadResult...| <= 4096B >> result: BlockReadResult...| <= 4096B
) = (.)

plot bot-storage-provider (
    request: BlockReadRequest...| <= 4096B >> result: BlockReadResult...| <= 4096B
) {
    literal: bytes/literal("")
    singleton: flow/singleton
    cell: state/seeded/flow/until
    route: bot-storage-route()
    join: flow/zip/feedback
    commands: flow/zip/feedback
    requests: flow/concat/finite
    events: flow/merge/finite
    transport-events: flow/merge/finite
    bulk-events: flow/merge/finite
    control: machine/usb/control
    observe-control: bot-storage-observe-control
    write: machine/usb/endpoint-write
    read: machine/usb/endpoint-read
    literal >> bot-storage-bootstrap() >> singleton.value
    singleton.flow >> bot-storage-start() >> cell.seed
    singleton.flow >> bot-storage-closed() >> requests.right
    request >> bot-storage-command() >> requests.left
    requests.concatenated >> commands.right
    cell.current >> route
    route >> bot-storage-pending() >> select(BotStoragePending.running, unmatched=drop) >> join.left
    route >> select(BotStorageRoute.ready, unmatched=drop) >> commands.left
    commands.paired >> bot-storage-command-event() >> events.left
    route >> select(BotStorageRoute.control, unmatched=drop) >> bot-storage-control-request() >> control.request
    route >> select(BotStorageRoute.write, unmatched=drop) >> bot-storage-write-request() >> write.request
    route >> select(BotStorageRoute.read, unmatched=drop) >> bot-storage-read-request() >> read.request
    control.result >> observe-control.result
    observe-control.event >> transport-events.left
    write.result >> bot-storage-write-observation() >> bulk-events.left
    read.result >> bot-storage-read-event() >> bot-storage-observation() >> bulk-events.right
    bulk-events.merged >> transport-events.right
    transport-events.merged >> events.right
    events.merged >> join.right
    join.paired >> bot-storage-accept() >> bot-storage-advance() >> cell.next
    join.paired >> bot-storage-accept() >> bot-storage-emission() >> select(BotStorageEmission.emit, unmatched=drop) >> bot-storage-result() >> result
}

plot bot-storage-permitted (
    permit: BlockReadPermit...| >> request: BlockReadRequest...|
) = ({ block_size: .block_size, count: .count, lba: .lba })
plot bot-storage-one-read (
    request: BlockReadRequest...| <= 4096B >> result: BlockReadResult...| <= 4096B
) {
    authorize: storage/block-read/authorize
    provider: bot-storage-provider
    settle: storage/block-read/settle
    request >> authorize.request
    authorize.result >> bot-storage-permitted() >> provider.request
    provider.result >> settle.request
    settle.result >> result
}

# Reviewed demonstration: issue the next read only after storage settlement.
# Each request consumes the independently admitted storage and USB budgets.
type BotReadProducerState = {
    request: BlockReadRequest
    operations: U64
    terminal: Boolean
}
type BotReadProducerRoute =
    running BotReadProducerState
    | stopped
plot bot-read-producer-start (
    request: BlockReadRequest...| <= 4096B >> state: BotReadProducerState...|
) = ({ request: ., operations: 0, terminal: .block_size != 512 || .count != 1 || .lba != 0 })
plot bot-read-producer-route (
    state: BotReadProducerState...| >> route: BotReadProducerRoute...|
) = (.terminal || .operations >= 16 ? stopped(empty) : running(.))
plot bot-read-producer-request (
    state: BotReadProducerState...| >> request: BlockReadRequest...|
) = (.request)
plot bot-read-producer-next (
    pair: BotReadProducerPair...| >> state: BotReadProducerState...|
) = ({ request: .0.request, operations: .0.operations < 16 ? .0.operations + 1 : .0.operations, terminal: .0.terminal || .0.operations >= 15 ? true : (!(.1 is completed) ? true : (.1.completed.ordinal != .0.operations || .1.completed.block_size != 512 || .1.completed.count != 1 || .1.completed.lba != 0 || .1.completed.actual != 512 || .1.completed.residue != 0 || .1.completed.short)) })
plot bot-storage-sixteen-read-demonstration (
    request: BlockReadRequest...| <= 4096B >> result: BlockReadResult...| <= 4096B
) {
    producer: ProducerCell
    join: ProducerJoin
    provider: bot-storage-one-read
    request >> bot-read-producer-start() >> producer.seed
    producer.current >> bot-read-producer-route() >> select(BotReadProducerRoute.running, unmatched=drop) >> bot-read-producer-request() >> provider.request
    producer.current >> bot-read-producer-route() >> select(BotReadProducerRoute.running, unmatched=drop) >> join.left
    provider.result >> join.right
    provider.result >> result
    join.paired >> bot-read-producer-next() >> producer.next
}
